description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the {@link FieldValidator} class in the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic for the {@link Field} entity, ensuring proper validation of fields such as name, selectMultiple, retired, and string length constraints.

classes.name: FieldValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the {@link FieldValidator} class, extending {@link BaseContextSensitiveTest} to provide context for OpenMRS validation tests.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the {@link Field} name is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the {@link Field} name is an empty string.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsAllWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the {@link Field} name contains only whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfSelectMultipleIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the {@link Field} selectMultiple property is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the {@link Field} retired property is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests successful validation when all the {@link Field} properties are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when string fields are within allowed length constraints.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when string fields exceed maximum allowed length.
